description: Column names, field names, types and descriptions for one dataset from the index, plus every distribution (format + URL), license, publisher, extent and per-field provenance (from the portal vs derived here). With standard 'croissant' (read by AI and ML tools) or 'dcat-us' (DCAT-US 3.0, read by government catalogs and data.gov), returns the dataset's description in that standard instead, with which required fields the portal did not give. A license is never inferred: where the portal gives none, a terms page may be linked, labeled 'terms page, not a license'.

dataset.description: dataset_id from search_datasets, a Socrata 4x4, an ArcGIS item id, or the dataset URL

standard.description: Return the description as Croissant 1.1 ('croissant') or DCAT-US 3.0 ('dcat-us') instead of the column list

name: get_dataset_columns
